# Stainess Scooter

> Motorbike and scooter workshop — repairs, parts, MOT prep, key fob services and weekly rental of Honda PCX, SH, SH Mode, Vision and Yamaha NMAX scooters.

Stainess Scooter is an independent workshop specialising in 125cc scooters and motorbikes. We repair every make and model, sell parts, program key fobs, and rent Honda and Yamaha scooters by the week.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of repairs, rental, parts and MOT prep.
- [Services](/services): Repair, fault finding, key fob programming, pre-MOT checks.
- [Rental](/rental): Weekly motorbike and scooter rental fleet and pricing.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, opening hours and directions.
